description: Every section of one Georgia Code chapter with its text, in order, windowed by max_sections (default 40) and max_chars (default 60,000); the output ends with a pointer to continue or 'End of chapter.'

chapter.description: The chapter number within the title, as printed: 5, 11A.
chapter.title: Chapter

max_chars.description: Most characters to return in this call, 1,000 to 200,000 (default 60,000). A longer document ends with a pointer to the next part.
max_chars.title: Max Chars

max_sections.description: Most sections to return in this call, 1 to 200 (default 40).
max_sections.title: Max Sections

start.description: How many of the chapter's sections to skip, as the previous call's continuation pointer says. 0 is the first section.
start.title: Start

title.description: The title number, 1 to 53 (Title 16 is Crimes and Offenses).
title.title: Title

name: code_get_chapter
title: Read a Georgia Code chapter
